March 15, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy 
Knightsbridge Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Bank Amer Corp (BAC) by 19.55% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Knightsbridge Asset Management Llc bought 62,487 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.00% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 382,153 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $9.68M, up from 319,666 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Knightsbridge Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Bank Amer Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $329.23 billion market cap company. It closed at $32.14 lastly. It is down 58.64% since March 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 41.94% the S&P500.
